name: TrailingTakeProfit
summary: This EA is a trailing take-profit utility that dynamically adjusts the take-profit level of existing positions as price moves in favor. It monitors open positions for a specified symbol and trails the TP behind the current price by a configurable distance once the price has moved beyond a starting threshold.
summary_zh: 这是一个追踪止盈工具EA，当价格朝有利方向移动时，动态调整现有持仓的止盈水平。它会监控指定交易品种的未平仓头寸，在价格超过起始阈值后，按可配置的距离将止盈跟踪在当前价格之后。
strategy_analysis: 此EA并非独立交易策略，而是一个仓位管理辅助工具。其核心概念是在持仓浮盈达到TrailingTPStart点数后，启动追踪止盈机制，将止盈价格保持在当前价格的TrailingTPDistance点数距离内。对于多头仓位，当开盘价减去当前价的差额超过起始阈值时，如果当前止盈高于当前价加距离阈值，则将止盈下移至当前价加距离值。对于空头仓位，逻辑相反：当当前价减去开盘价的差额超过起始阈值时，如果当前止盈低于当前价减距离阈值，则将止盈上移至当前价减距离值。该EA不涉及任何入场信号生成或仓位开立，仅对已有持仓进行止盈管理。仓位管理和资金管理完全由用户或其他EA负责，本工具不涉及。风险方面，该EA不设置止损也不修改止损，仅修改止盈，且没有对修改失败进行处理。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a standalone trading strategy but a position management utility. Its core concept is to activate a trailing take-profit mechanism once the floating profit on a position exceeds the TrailingTPStart threshold in points. It then keeps the take-profit level within TrailingTPDistance points of the current price. For buy positions, when the difference between the open price and current price exceeds the start threshold, and the current TP is above the current price plus the distance, it moves the TP down to the current price plus the distance value. For sell positions, the logic is reversed: when the current price minus the open price exceeds the start threshold, and the current TP is below the current price minus the distance, it moves the TP up to the current price minus the distance value. This EA does not generate any entry signals or open positions; it solely manages the take-profit of existing positions. Position sizing and money management are entirely the user's responsibility or handled by another EA. Regarding risk, this EA neither sets nor modifies stop-losses, only take-profits, and it does not handle order modification failures.

parameters.name: TrailingTP_Mode
parameters.description: 追踪止盈模式开关，true为启用
parameters.description_en: Trailing take profit mode toggle; true to enable

parameters.name: Symbol_Name
parameters.description: 要监控的交易品种名称

parameters.name: TrailingTPStart
parameters.description: 追踪止盈启动阈值（点数），浮盈超过此值后开始追踪
parameters.description_en: Trailing TP start threshold (points); begins trailing above this

parameters.name: TrailingTPDistance
parameters.description: 追踪止盈距离（点数），止盈与当前价格的最大距离
parameters.description_en: Trailing TP distance (points); max gap between TP and price

pros: 逻辑简洁明了，代码易于理解和维护
支持多头和空头双向持仓的追踪止盈管理
参数设计合理，起始阈值和追踪距离分离，提供灵活性
使用MQL5标准库类（CTrade、CPositionInfo、CSymbolInfo），代码规范性较好
pros_en: Clean and straightforward logic, easy to understand and maintain
Supports trailing take-profit for both buy and sell positions
Well-designed parameters with separate start threshold and trailing distance for flexibility
Uses MQL5 standard library classes (CTrade, CPositionInfo, CSymbolInfo) for good code standards
cons: 不处理PositionModify调用失败的情况，修改订单可能静默失败
买入仓位的启动条件逻辑错误：PriceOpen()-PriceCurrent()>阈值意味着价格下跌才触发，与追踪止盈意图相反
缺少点数规范化处理，不同品种的点值可能不同，未使用符号信息进行适配
没有防重入机制，每个tick都会尝试修改，可能增加服务器负担
不处理止损为0的情况，可能传递无效止损值给PositionModify
cons_en: Does not handle PositionModify call failures; order modifications may silently fail
Critical logic error in buy position: PriceOpen()-PriceCurrent()>threshold triggers when price drops, opposite of trailing TP intent
Lacks point value normalization; different symbols may have different point values without symbol-specific adaptation
No re-entry prevention mechanism; attempts modification every tick, potentially increasing server load
Does not handle zero stop-loss, potentially passing invalid SL values to PositionModify
improvements: 修复买入仓位的逻辑错误：应改为PriceCurrent()-PriceOpen()>STtp*Point()，即价格上涨超过阈值才触发追踪止盈
添加PositionModify返回值检查和错误处理逻辑，并在修改前检查止损和止盈是否需要变更以避免无效请求
增加点数规范化处理，使用NormalizeDouble确保价格精度，并考虑不同品种的最小变动价位
improvements_en: Fix the buy position logic error: change to PriceCurrent()-PriceOpen()>STtp*Point() so trailing TP activates when price rises beyond the threshold, matching the intended behavior
Add PositionModify return value checking and error handling, and verify whether SL/TP actually need changing before submitting modification requests
Add price normalization using NormalizeDouble for proper price precision, and account for different symbols' minimum tick sizes

risk_points: 买入仓位触发条件存在严重逻辑错误，可能导致在亏损时修改止盈而非盈利时
不检查订单修改结果，修改失败时无法感知和重试
每tick都尝试修改订单，高频调用可能被交易服务器限制或断开连接
risk_points_en: Critical logic error in buy position trigger condition may cause TP modification during loss rather than profit
No order modification result checking; failures go undetected without retry capability
Attempts modification every tick without throttling; high-frequency calls may trigger server rate limits or disconnection
